newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Quality Handling to open perishables centre by end.
newsitem.headline: Quality Handling to open perishables centre by end.

text.p: Quality Handling is aiming to open its new Perishables Centre at Amsterdam Schiphol Aiport by the end of August.
The 2,200 sq m facility is for handling vegetables and flowers and is equipped with cooling and packing facilities, said owner, Wim Visbeen.
As well as Quality Handling, Visbeen's headquarters and administrative centre will be based at the centre which has 600 sq m of offices.
Quality Handling will take on third party business at the centre, as well as working for Visbeen.
Most of Visbeen's work involves vegetables but around 30-35 percent of it is with flowers, the firm said.
Visbeen's forwarding arm will retain an operational office at the Aalsmeer flower market.
There is likely to be more activity coming from the imports side, said Visbeen, as more flowers and vegetable are being imported from Africa, Israel and South America, he said.
"Many companies used to be exporters of Dutch produce and now they are international traders of imports and exports,"said Visbeen.
